not_checked.axis: How good GPT-6 Astra actually is
not_checked.why_not: No benchmark covers it. It inherits a score from the lane the directive calls its equal, and the page says so wherever that score is used.

not_checked.axis: What GPT-6 Astra and Gemini 3.8 cost
not_checked.why_not: No published price. Each stands in at its predecessor's, and the cheapest-wins step steps aside rather than trusting it.
The 8-of-12 failure rate was measured on 3.7. It is not charged to 3.8; the lane carries the condition instead.
